name: Tourist/Visit Visa (List-A countries)
summary: Citizens of the List-A countries (190 listed) can get a tourist visa valid 3 months for double entry. It can be extended by regional offices to 6 months total. US nationals can get 5 years, multiple entry, up to 3 months per stay, from Pakistani missions.

other: See the official DGI&P list of List-A countries.

stay.note: Extendable to 6 months total. US nationals: 5 year multiple entry visa, up to 3 months per stay.

name: Visa in Your Inbox (Pakistan Online Visa)
summary: Apply online with the Pakistan Online Visa System. The portal says it is open to 175 countries, while the DGI&P home page says 192. Processing is listed as 7 to 10 working days.

other: Country counts differ between the official pages, so check the portal for your passport.

name: Visa on Arrival (tourist, 50 countries)
summary: Citizens of 50 listed countries can get a visa on arrival, usually for 30 days. You need an electronic travel authorization 48 to 72 hours before you travel. Qatari passports get 30 days, extendable by 30.

other: Electronic travel authorization needed 48 to 72 hours in advance.
Country list is on the official portal.

name: Business Visa
summary: For business visitors from 96 listed countries. It is valid 5 years, multiple entry, with a 30-day visa on arrival option. It needs a recommendation or invitation letter from a qualifying body.

other: Invitation or recommendation letter from a qualifying body.

stay.note: 5 years multiple entry. Processing within 24 hours per DGI&P.

name: Work Visa (entry and extension)
summary: The entry work visa is valid up to 3 months, single entry, processed within 48 hours with no security clearance. The extension can go up to 2 years, multiple entry, and needs security clearance and a Board of Investment recommendation letter. The portal also lists a CPEC projects work visa.

other: Extension needs security clearance and a BOI recommendation letter.

stay.note: Entry visa up to 3 months, single entry. Extension up to 2 years.

sources.label: Pakistan Online Visa System, work visas

name: Business and Investor Visas (including SIFC)
summary: The Pakistan Online Visa System has Business-Investor and SIFC Investor visa pages. We could not read them, so amounts, durations and conditions are not confirmed.

other: Investment amounts and conditions not confirmed.

name: Family Visit Visa (Pakistan-origin foreigners)
summary: For foreigners of Pakistani origin and their foreign spouses. It is valid 5 years, multiple entry, with 1 year per stay, processed in 7 to 10 working days. It can be extended yearly inside Pakistan.

other: Pakistani-origin foreigner or the foreign spouse of one.

stay.note: 1 year stay per visit, extendable yearly in Pakistan.

name: Study Visa
summary: The page lists a 2 year study visa under the revised policy. It needs no-objection certificates from the relevant ministries and security clearance, which should take about 30 days. The page also mentions an older 1 year policy, so confirm the current rule.

other: NOCs from relevant ministries and security clearance.
Page mentions both a 2 year and an older 1 year policy.

name: Medical Visa
summary: Short term medical visa is up to 3 months, single entry, processed in 48 hours. The extended one is up to 1 year, multiple entry, and needs hospital letters and security clearance.

other: Hospital letters needed for the extended visa.

stay.note: Extended medical visa up to 1 year, multiple entry.

name: Visa-free entry (list and GCC)
summary: DGI&P lists 49 countries with visa-free entry, mostly for diplomatic and official passports. Maldives and Nepal cover all nationals. The DGI&P home page also says GCC countries are exempt for business, tourism and Sikh pilgrimage, which conflicts with the visa-on-arrival wording, so treat it as unconfirmed.

other: GCC exemption wording is unclear on the official page.
Other listed countries are mostly diplomatic or official passports only.
